patterns.title: Declaration and definition chronology can change GC/1.3.2 output
patterns.summary: Moving file-scope definitions earlier can change one-pass visibility, register allocation, section extents, and relocations even when the C declarations appear equivalent.
patterns.conditions: Apply as a compiler-wide diagnostic under GC/1.3.2; probe each owner locally because stage.c is a counterexample to the mdparty tail-definition requirement.

source_condition.change: Move file-scope object definitions earlier or otherwise alter declaration/definition chronology while retaining nominally equivalent declarations.

known_signatures: a semantics-preserving reorder regresses many exact functions
section extent changes without an intentional data-layout change

patterns.rule: Treat declaration chronology as a testable compiler variable; do not modernize definition placement or copy a tail-definition layout without owner-local proof.
safe_actions: make a bounded owner-local chronology probe
compare every independently exact function and affected data section
record both positive and negative owner results

patterns.title: Keep mdparty same-owner definitions at the authenticated tail position
patterns.summary: mdparty.c requires declarations before code and the same-owner definitions at the translation-unit tail to retain the retail text, BSS, and relocation chronology.
patterns.conditions: This is specific to REL:mdpartydll:mdparty and must not be copied to stage.c or another owner.

source_condition.change: Move one or more mdparty-owned object definitions before application code or regroup the authenticated reverse tail order.

known_signatures: early-definition probe retained only 154 of 258 exact functions
source text and BSS extents diverged from retail

patterns.rule: Preserve the authenticated mdparty declaration-before-code and reverse tail-definition chronology unless stronger same-game evidence disproves it.
safe_actions: leave the existing tail chronology intact during semantic cleanup
test any ownership cleanup in an isolated probe before retaining it
verify the complete relocation stream after data-definition changes

patterns.title: A broader correct header can still produce the wrong translation-unit output
patterns.summary: Adding semantically correct declarations through a broad header can change emitted calls, temporary lifetimes, allocation, and inline behavior when the retail translation unit saw a narrower declaration set.
patterns.conditions: Use as a compiler-wide diagnostic; local prototypes are acceptable only when symbol authority and an owner-specific visibility probe support them.

source_condition.change: Replace target-visible local prototypes with a broad owner header or add declarations that were not visible in the retail translation unit.
requires: the include changes the visible declaration set

known_signatures: one exact caller becomes eight bytes shorter
several independently exact functions diverge after a header-only cleanup

patterns.rule: Do not treat broader modern header visibility as historically authentic merely because the declarations are correct; reproduce and test the retail translation-unit visibility.
safe_actions: compare the preprocessed declaration set before and after the include
run an owner-local broad-header probe
retain narrow local declarations only with symbol authority and recorded evidence

patterns.title: Retain the target-visible mdparty audio declarations without the broad audio header
patterns.summary: fn_1_2F22C is exact only when mdparty sees the four authenticated local audio declarations rather than the complete audio header.
patterns.conditions: Applies to the authenticated mdparty translation-unit visibility; it is not a general license for duplicate local prototypes.

source_condition.change: Include game/audio.h in mdparty.c or otherwise expose the full audio declaration set to fn_1_2F22C.

known_signatures: fn_1_2F22C becomes eight bytes shorter with the broad header

patterns.rule: Keep the four policy-checked local audio declarations and do not include the broad audio header in mdparty.c without new target evidence.
safe_actions: keep signatures mirrored against the authoritative audio header
let the declaration-ownership gate detect drift
re-run fn_1_2F22C and its caller evidence after any audio contract change

patterns.title: Retain stage's authenticated signed random prototypes
patterns.summary: stage.c requires its target-backed signed frandmod and rand8 declarations; broad random-function headers change five exact functions.
patterns.conditions: Specific to REL:mdpartydll:stage and its retail declaration visibility.

source_condition.change: Replace stage's local signed frandmod/rand8 prototypes with a broader random-function header.

known_signatures: broad random visibility reduces source text from the retail extent and diverges five functions

patterns.rule: Keep the two target-backed signed local prototypes in stage.c unless stronger same-game evidence authenticates broader visibility.
safe_actions: keep symbol authority in the declaration policy
compare all 57 stage functions after random-contract changes
do not copy this exception to another owner

patterns.title: Check helper boundaries and object lifetimes before adding code-generation controls
patterns.summary: Real helper boundaries, automatic inline decisions, narrow contracts, and block-scoped lifetimes can explain repeated register and control-flow mismatches across related callers.
patterns.conditions: Use when the same mismatch family appears around calls, saved registers, temporary elimination, or nested control flow; a single isolated match is insufficient.

source_condition.change: Flatten or recreate helpers, widen a narrow contract, or move a temporary outside its likely original block scope.
requires: a repeated mismatch family across related call sites
target or sibling evidence for the helper or contract

known_signatures: multiple callers close together after restoring one helper family
a block-scope or signed-contract correction removes one repeated temporary

patterns.rule: Before using pragmas or artificial expressions, test the authenticated helper boundary, narrow type contract, and block lifetime that could naturally produce the mismatch family.
safe_actions: compare the same helper pattern across all known callers
test signedness and scope independently
retain the change only when related callers improve without exact regressions

patterns.title: Recover narrow signed contracts from target and consumer widths before widening to int
patterns.summary: Signed-short parameters and returns can change extension nodes, temporary lifetimes, branches, and wrapped allocator chronology even when an int signature appears semantically equivalent.
patterns.conditions: Use as a compiler-wide type diagnostic when callers, symbol data, or target instructions show 16-bit signed movement or extension.

source_condition.change: Widen an s16 argument or return contract to int, or insert casts that erase the original signed-short node.

known_signatures: an exact body closes only after restoring an s16 return
multiple inline boundaries share the same signed argument-node difference

patterns.rule: Choose narrow signed types from target and consumer evidence, not from modern convenience or one function's isolated code generation.
safe_actions: inspect caller and consumer widths before changing the signature
compare extension instructions at every boundary
re-test all Matching consumers of a shared declaration
